test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Manish has being applying / for colleges / ever since he passed / his entrance test in March.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb phrase "**has being applying**."
 
• The correct form should be "**has been applying**."
 
• The verb "being" is incorrect in this context and should be replaced with the verb "been" to form the present perfect continuous tense correctly.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Manish has been applying for colleges ever since he passed his entrance test in March."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **for colleges** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **ever since he passed** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **his entrance test in March** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
